title: Mastering SQL Joins & Relational Analysis
objective: Understand INNER, LEFT, RIGHT, and FULL joins through visual set theory and interactive queries.

segments.title: Why Relational Joins Matter
segments.narration_text: Welcome to SQL Joins. In relational databases, data lives in normalized tables. Today we connect them.

board_events.accessible_text: Visualizing Table A joined with Table B

quiz.prompt: Which JOIN returns all rows from the left table even if no match exists in the right table?
quiz.explanation: LEFT JOIN preserves every row from the left table, populating NULL for missing right-side values.
